description: A drag-and-drop ready, feature-rich WYSIWYG HTML Editor control for Windows Forms applications by SpiceLogic Inc. Switch between visual editing, HTML source mode, and preview mode with synchronized selection across modes. Includes built-in spell checker (NHunspell, OpenOffice, NetSpell dictionaries), customizable toolbar, CSS style builder, table manipulation, image insertion with Base64 embedding, clean MS Word paste conversion to XHTML, FTP image upload, hyperlink management, YouTube video embedding, and a comprehensive content manipulation API with caret positioning, HTML change events, and custom paste handling. Targets .NET Framework 4.5+ and .NET 5 through .NET 10.
releaseNotes: Fixed the editor disappearing from the modern Visual Studio designer when consuming the control through a ProjectReference. The source reference now supplies the complete bundled dependency set to design-time assembly resolution. Verified at 200% scaling on .NET 6, 8, 9 and 10, with classic .NET Framework designer actions and clean form serialization preserved. ALM bug #1498.
title: SpiceLogic .NET WinForms HTML Editor Control
